sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Prakhar Srivastava,Prabhat Kumar Srivastava Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Matiur Rehman Khan,Saqib Ahmad Hon'ble Sanjay Kumar Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned Additional Government Advocate representing the State and learned counsel appearing on behalf of the informant.

The instant bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. has been filed on behalf of the applicant with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No. 303 of 2022, under Sections 376, 366, 506 I.P.C., Police Station-Kotwali, District-Ballia, during the pendency of trial.

In this case, First Information Report was registered on 21.06.2022 through an application under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C. dated 19.01.2022 against Tanvir Alam (present applicant) and Zareen with the allegations inter-alia that the applicant has been making physical relation with her daughter for the last two years and when she came to know about their relation, she solemnized her marriage Tanvir Alam vs State Of U.P. on 18 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103963410/
1 with Aftab Alam.

sentences.text: In August 2020, her daughter came to her parental house (maika), but both the applicant and her daughter again started meeting together with each other.
Thereafter the applicant took her to Ludhiana by coaxing her and after long time, victim informed her about her location.

The informant along with her husband went to Ludhiana and brought her back along with applicant on the promise of the applicant that he will marry her, but applicant instead of marrying her again started making physical relation with her daughter on the pretext of said marriage and later on he refused for the marriage.
The main substratum of argument of learned counsel for the applicant is that the victim is an adult lady and she was consenting party with the applicant.

It is also pointed out that as per prosecution case itself, victim had made physical relation with the applicant even after her marriage with Aftab Alam and again without giving any information to her husband and to her parents, fled to Ludhiana along with the applicant.

It is also pointed out that when she was produced for her medical examination, she has refused for the same and after culmination of investigation, charge-sheet has been submitted in this case on 28.09.2022.
On the strength of aforesaid submissions, learned counsel for the applicant submits that it is not a case of rape but it is a case of consensual relation between the parties concerned.
The applicant who is languishing in jail since 06.07.2022 may be enlarged on bail.
In case the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will cooperate in early disposal of the case.
Per contra, learned A.G.A. for the State as well as learned counsel for the informant opposed the prayer for bail of the applicant but could not dispute the factum of the case.

Having heard learned counsel for the parties and examined the matter in its entirety, I find that there is no dispute that the victim is a married woman and she was consenting party with the applicant.

Even the F.I.R. version shows that she was very much inclined towards the applicant and she, in order to achieve her aim of marriage with the applicant, made physical relation with him on her own volition.

I also find substance in the submission of learned counsel for the applicant that the victim was capable to understand the significance and morality associated with the act, for which she was consenting.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case as well as keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused and submissions of the learned counsel for the parties, I am of the view that the applicant has made out a fit case for bail.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

Let the applicant-Tanvir Alam, be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions which are being imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) That the applicant shall cooperate in the expeditious disposal of the trial and shall regularly attend the court unless inevitable.

sentences.text: (ii) That the applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) That after his release, the applicant shall not involve in any criminal activity.
(iv) The identity, status and residential proof of sureties will be verified by court concerned before the release of the applicant on bail.
In case of breach of any of the conditions mentioned above, court concerned will be at liberty to cancel the bail of the applicant.
